# HomeService USA

> HomeService USA (homeservice-usa.com) is an independent, editorial home-services information site for American homeowners. It publishes cost guides, troubleshooting guides, and contractor-vetting advice for plumbing, HVAC, roofing, electrical, pest control, and general home repair. The site does not sell leads, list paid contractors, or accept payment from service providers to influence recommendations. All cost data is presented as ranges in USD, current as of the article's stated publish date, and sourced against government and industry references (EPA, DOE, ENERGY STAR, IRS, FEMA, CPSC, NFPA, HUD, NAHB) where applicable.

## About

- [About HomeService USA](https://homeservice-usa.com/about/): Site mission, editorial approach, and disclosure that no paid contractor listings or lead-generation relationships exist.

## City & Local Guides

City pillar pages summarize local climate risk, housing stock, and licensing rules; city-service pages give locally adjusted cost ranges for a specific trade.

- [All city guides](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/): Index of every city guide.
- [Houston, TX](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/houston-tx/): Gulf Coast heat, flooding, and freeze risk. Includes [HVAC](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/houston-tx/hvac/), [plumbing](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/houston-tx/plumbing/), [roofing](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/houston-tx/roofing/).
- [Phoenix, AZ](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/phoenix-az/): Extreme desert heat and monsoon storms. Includes [HVAC](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/phoenix-az/hvac/), [roofing](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/phoenix-az/roofing/).
- [Miami, FL](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/miami-fl/): Hurricane risk and strict Florida Building Code requirements. Includes [HVAC](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/miami-fl/hvac/), [roofing](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/miami-fl/roofing/).
- [Dallas, TX](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/dallas-tx/): High hail frequency and winter freeze risk. Includes [HVAC](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/dallas-tx/hvac/), [plumbing](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/dallas-tx/plumbing/), [roofing](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/dallas-tx/roofing/).
- [Atlanta, GA](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/atlanta-ga/): Humid summers and severe thunderstorm/tree-fall risk. Includes [HVAC](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/atlanta-ga/hvac/), [roofing](https://homeservice-usa.com/locations/atlanta-ga/roofing/).
